results.name: get --lease warns on stderr, preserves path-only stdout, and does not execute repository hooks
repositories with no config or no hooks produce no ignored-hooks warning
bulk destroy deduplicates repeated checks while naming ignored keys and the user config destination
destroying a named worktree from outside its repository warns only for that worktree owner
bulk destroy warns exactly once for each owning repository in its target snapshot
destroy remains non-fatal and removes its target when repository configuration is malformed
user pre_destroy runs for disposable, leased, and dirty removals but not for dry-run
